# Rustywoof Documentation

Rustywoof is a CLI tool designed to detect exposed cryptographic credentials and compromised dependencies.

## Key Capabilities
- Secret Scanning: Aho-Corasick automaton for O(n) literal prefix matching.
- Dependency Auditing: OSV network queries for Node, Rust, and Python lockfiles.
- Perimeter Defense: Git pre-commit hook management.

## Installation
`curl -sSL https://rustywoof.dev/installer.sh | sh`

## Documentation Index
- /docs/cli : CLI Reference
- /docs/concepts : Core Architecture & Threat Models
- /docs/configuration : The .woof.toml File
